proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ F M φ hM hc hcont hi
  refine MeasureTheory.submartingale_nat (fun n => hcont.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hM.stronglyAdapted n)) hi fun n => ?_
  have hJ := hc.map_condExp_le (F.le n) (hcont.lowerSemicontinuous.lowerSemicontinuousOn _) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => Set.mem_univ _) isClosed_univ (hM.integrable (n + 1)) (hi (n + 1))
  filter_upwards [hJ, hM.condExp_ae_eq (Nat.le_succ n)] with ω w1 w2
  have : φ (M n ω) = (φ ∘ MeasureTheory.condExp (F n) P (M (n + 1))) ω := by simp [Function.comp, w2]
  rw [this]
  exact w1
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Martingale M F P → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ φ → Continuous φ → (∀ n, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => φ (M n ω)) P) → MeasureTheory.Submartingale (fun n ω => φ (M n ω)) F P
